api:
<Bump data={standings} x={|r: &Rank| r.year} name={|r: &Rank| r.team} value={|r: &Rank| r.points} />
PropTypeDefault
xFn(&T) -> f64: the round, year or steprequired
nameFn(&T) -> &str: which line the row belongs torequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64: the score that is rankedrequired
highest_firstbool: rank 1 is the highest valuetrue
smoothbooltrue
x_axisAxisConfigwhole numbers

Rows are long format: one row per item per step. At each step the items are ranked by value; the y axis shows rank 1 at the top.

examples.title: League table
examples.description: Each team's rank per season, rank 1 at the top.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn league() {
    let data = use_signal(standings());
    rsx! { <Bump data={data} x={|r: &Rank| r.year} name={|r: &Rank| r.team} value={|r: &Rank| r.points} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Eight teams, twelve seasons
examples.description: A busier table where the lines cross often.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn big_league() {
    let data = use_signal(ranking(
        &[
            "Lions", "Tigers", "Bears", "Wolves", "Eagles", "Hawks", "Sharks", "Giants",
        ],
        2014..=2025,
    ));
    rsx! { <Bump data={data} x={|r: &Rank| r.year} name={|r: &Rank| r.team} value={|r: &Rank| r.points} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Race results
examples.description: Six drivers over twelve races with the lowest value ranked first.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn lap_times() {
    let data = use_signal(ranking(
        &[
            "Alonso",
            "Hamilton",
            "Verstappen",
            "Leclerc",
            "Norris",
            "Russell",
        ],
        2010..=2021,
    ));
    rsx! { <Bump data={data} x={|r: &Rank| r.year} name={|r: &Rank| r.team} value={|r: &Rank| r.points} highest_first={false} legend={Legend::list().bottom()} x_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("Race")} class="h-80" /> }
}
